nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint256) storing token balances; mutated in transfer and transferFrom.
Public string token name 'FGRE_Portfolio_III_883'.
Public string token symbol 'FGRE883III'.
Public uint8 decimals value 18.
Public uint256 total supply, assigned entirely to the deployer in the constructor.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of spending allowances; written in approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Constructor-like public function minting the whole totalSupply to msg.sender and emitting Transfer.
Public token transfer; requires sufficient sender balance and updates balances with unchecked -= / +=.
Public allowance setter; writes allowance[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
Public delegated transfer; requires balance and allowance, then mutates balances and allowance with unchecked arithmetic.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and balance/allowance indexing in all state-changing functions.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer used in the balance subtraction and addition.
Spender address parameter of approve, used as allowance key.
Allowance amount parameter of approve, written into allowance.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, indexed for balanceOf and allowance.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used in the require checks and unchecked balance/allowance mutations.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer; unchecked arithmetic underflow risk.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[to] += value in transfer; unchecked arithmetic overflow risk.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic underflow risk.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic overflow risk.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic underflow risk.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines who receives the entire totalSupply in the constructor-like function.
msg.sender is used to index the sender balance in transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance mapping written by approve.
msg.sender is used as spender index in transferFrom allowance check and decrement.
The to parameter is the recipient key of the balance addition in transfer.
The value parameter is subtracted from the sender balance without overflow checks.
The value parameter is added to the recipient balance without overflow checks.
The spender parameter is the key written in the allowance mapping by approve.
The value parameter is the allowance amount stored by approve.
The from parameter indexes the balance subtracted without overflow checks in transferFrom.
The from parameter indexes the allowance subtracted without overflow checks in transferFrom.
The to parameter indexes the balance added without overflow checks in transferFrom.
The value parameter is subtracted from balanceOf[from] without overflow checks.
The value parameter is added to balanceOf[to] without overflow checks.
The value parameter is subtracted from the spender allowance without overflow checks.
The constructor writes the whole totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor reads totalSupply to assign the initial balance.
The unchecked subtraction mutates the sender entry of the balanceOf state variable.
The unchecked addition mutates the recipient entry of the balanceOf state variable.
The unchecked subtraction mutates the from entry of the balanceOf state variable.
The unchecked addition mutates the to entry of the balanceOf state variable.
The unchecked subtraction mutates the allowance state variable.
approve writes the allowance mapping entry for msg.sender and spender.
transfer executes the sender balance deduction after the require check.
transfer executes the recipient balance addition after the deduction.
transferFrom executes the from balance deduction after the require checks.
transferFrom executes the to balance addition after the deduction.
transferFrom executes the allowance decrement after the balance updates.
Only the deployer-holding state created by the constructor enables transfer flows.
Both public transfer entry points mutate shared balanceOf state and could be re-entered from a malicious recipient contract.
State is mutated before any external interaction pattern is settled, exposing reentrancy-style state inconsistency on the to balance.
approve establishes the allowance consumed later by transferFrom.
